value.displayTitle: The humanities belong inside the AI revolution
value.summary: Not as resistance to technology, but as part of learning how to use it.
On anthropomorphising AI without forgetting what it is.
Why AI increases the value of judgment rather than eliminating it.
Boston, friction, meaning and a world of instant outcomes.
